title: Project Pele First TRISO Fuel Delivery
summary: Idaho National Laboratory reported production and delivery of Project Pele's first batch of TRISO fuel to the Transient Reactor Test Facility, a physical milestone for the planned mobile microreactor demonstration.
key_findings: The fuel was delivered to the Idaho National Laboratory site intended for the demonstration.
The release identifies INL, the Strategic Capabilities Office, the Army, BWXT, and DOE as collaborators.
The source characterizes the batch as the first TRISO microreactor fuel delivered to its final destination.
why_it_matters: This is the strongest physical production milestone in the collection and advances the advanced-nuclear lane beyond strategy, funding, and ground-breaking.
ftfn_relevance: Adds produced and delivered project hardware to the implementation ladder.
Defines the next gates as reactor assembly, authorization, fuel loading, startup, criticality, power operation, and test results.
evidence_limits: Fuel delivery does not prove the reactor is assembled, licensed or authorized, fueled, critical, or generating power.
The release does not establish demonstration performance, mobility, safety results, cost, commercial readiness, or follow-on deployment.
